items.prompt: Which check distinguishes an absent key from a key explicitly storing None?

options.text: Use "fee_cents" in trade to test membership
options.why: Membership checks key presence independently of its value.
Both cases produce None with the default.

options.text: Replace every None with the integer zero
options.why: That destroys the distinction instead of observing it.

options.text: Convert the whole dictionary to an unordered set
options.why: That is not a value-presence test and loses needed structure.

items.explanation: Membership checks whether a key exists. Retrieving None alone cannot distinguish absent from present-with-None when both are allowed.
